source: StrykerJS mutant #15 (Regex), reproduced from the spike report

expected.mutant:
throws: cannot resolve a node with !<tag:yaml.org,2002:int> explicit tag (1:4)

 1 | a: !!int -0b101
--------^

note: In the explicit-integer pattern the binary alternative's optional sign becomes a negated class, so an explicitly tagged signed binary integer no longer resolves and the loader reports an unresolvable node. Reaching it needs an explicit `!!int` tag carrying a signed non-decimal literal, an input class the 314-test suite never generates.
